headlines.title: US Strikes Iran in Wake of Surprise Attack on American Forces
headlines.description: The United States launched major strikes against Iran Thursday morning after President Donald Trump vowed to hit the regime “very hard” as retaliation for a surprise attack on American forces in the region earlier in the week. It comes as a new poll shows 72% of Americans disapprove of the president's handling of Iran. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Trump vows retaliatory strike after failed Iranian attack
headlines.description: President Trump is vowing a retaliatory strike against Iran after the Iranian regime unsuccessfully attempted to attack U.S. troops. NBC News’ Garrett Haake reports.

headlines.title: Battling wildfires across Europe
headlines.description: Fires continue to rage across Europe, including in France’s wine country. NBC News’ Raf Sanchez was with firefighters and volunteers in the region as they battled the flames.

headlines.title: Pope Leo XIV reflects on being the first American pope
headlines.description: In a visit with “Nightly News” anchor Tom Llamas, Pope Leo XIV described his role as the first American pontiff. “I have great love for America,” he said. “But I understand my mission as having a very important dimension, which is precisely being pastor of a universal church.”

headlines.title: Fauci testifies before the Senate on the Covid pandemic
headlines.description: Watch live coverage as Dr. Anthony Fauci testifies before the Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee as part of Committee Chairman Rand Paul's investigation into the origins of Covid. Lawmakers are expected to question Fauci about what he knew and didn't know as the pandemic was unfolding.

headlines.title: Iran vows to ‘punish the aggressor today’ after U.S. unleashes ‘heavy wave’ of strikes
headlines.description: Iran vowed to “punish” the United States on Thursday after the American military said it had completed a “heavy wave of strikes” overnight, the latest retaliation for an attack by Tehran on U.S. forces in the Middle East.

headlines.title: Deodorant for kids: Derms talk the right age for deodorant and the best ones for young skin
headlines.description: Kids are hitting puberty earlier — and needing deodorant sooner. Dermatologists share the best kids’ deodorants for sensitive skin, plus when and how kids should start using them.

headlines.title: Skechers are up to 49% off just in time for your trips to Paris, Rome and other cities with cobblestone streets
headlines.description: Skechers walking shoes are up to 49 percent off right now — they’re perfect for summer travel to cities with cobblestone streets and for all-day comfort at theme parks.

headlines.title: One editor, 16 products, 3 months — my full brand review of Beyonce’s Cécred hair care
headlines.description: I put Cécred’s viral hair care to the test and tried 16 products, including shampoos, conditioners, treatments and more, to see what really lives up to the hype.

headlines.title: The best editor-approved meat delivery services in 2026
headlines.description: We tested steak, chicken, seafood and more from brands like Omaha Steaks, Butcherbox, and Lobsterboys to see which has the best meat delivery service for your next BBQ.

headlines.title: Republicans Delay Key Vote on Todd Blanche’s DOJ Nomination
headlines.description: President Donald Trump’s pick to lead the Department of Justice could be in jeopardy after Republicans postponed a key vote set for Thursday on Todd Blanche’s nomination amid a showdown with two GOP senators. NBC’s Kelly O’Donnell reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Anthony Fauci invokes Fifth Amendment right not to testify at Covid hearing
headlines.description: In his opening statement, the former top health official accused Sen. Rand Paul of having an “unhinged obsession” with him and wanting him put “behind bars.”
